title: Separability for relative extensions of object unital strongly groupoid graded rings
summary: We prove that if $R$ is a ring that is object unital and strongly graded by a groupoid $Γ$, and if $Δ$ is a wide subgroupoid of $Γ$, then $R/R_Δ$ is separable if and only if, for each $e \in Γ_0$, there exist $f \in [e]$ and $r \in C_{R_0}(R_Λ) := \{ x \in R_0 \mid xy = yx \text{ for all } y \in R_Λ\}$ with ${\rm tr}_{Γ/Δ}^f(r) = 1_{R_f}$. Here, $Γ_0$ denotes the set of objects of $Γ$, $[e]$ the connected component of $Γ_0$ containing $e$, $Λ$ the isotropy groupoid of $Δ$, and ${\rm tr}_{Γ/Δ}^f$ the relative trace map at $f$.
